risk_summary: The excerpt is largely precise and well quantified, with detailed sales, margin, geographic, restructuring, impairment, and financing data. Risk is mixed: profitability improved materially, but weak marine and industrial markets, restructuring charges, goodwill impairment, and dependence on recovering oil-and-gas demand indicate meaningful operating vulnerability. The extensive forward-looking disclaimer and truncated credit-agreement discussion limit assessment of covenant and liquidity risk.
